title: rhadamanth and gyges: install rustup by route C
objective:
Install rustup on rhadamanth and on gyges by route C: `brew install rustup`, then `rustup-init -y --no-modify-path`. Keep brew `rust`.

Start: on devbin-vc's GO, after Intent 3.5.6 is published and each machine's batch is done. molt-vc passes the GO to rhadamanth-sysadm, which holds route C's steps and hv's yes of 26 Nov. gyges-sysadm takes its GO from devbin-vc.

Proof: on each machine, `which -a cargo` and `cargo --version` in a fresh login shell.

Source: issue 0079's owed proof; vc's board, todo 41.
